_comment: Karafka Simplified Technical English (STE) term list. INSPIRED BY the ASD-STE100 dictionary; this is our own curated list and NOT a redistribution of the ASD dictionary. Consumed by .rules/no-unapproved-terms.js. Add words here to extend the controlled vocabulary. Keep 'substitutions' safe and exact (1:1, inflection-matched, collocation-independent) so auto-fix stays reliable; put anything context- or collocation-dependent in 'flag'.
_docs: See Development/Technical-Writing.md for the full house style and the rationale behind each entry.

flag.suggest: Context-dependent, do not blanket-swap. As a guarantee (a mechanism/property 'ensures' X) keep 'ensure' or use 'guarantees'; only as an instruction to the reader use 'make sure that <clause>'.
Context-dependent. Guarantee -> keep 'ensures' or use 'guarantees'; instruction -> 'makes sure that <clause>'.
Context-dependent. Guarantee -> keep 'ensuring'; instruction -> 'making sure that <clause>'.
Context-dependent. Guarantee -> keep 'ensured' or use 'guaranteed'; instruction -> 'made sure that <clause>'.
Collocation-dependent. 'about' fits informational nouns (information/questions/details regarding -> about); capability/policy/compatibility nouns take 'for'/'on'/'in'/'with', or keep 'regarding'.
Collocation-dependent. Prefer 'about' for informational nouns; otherwise 'for'/'on'/'with', or keep 'concerning'.
Do not swap to 'got'. The past participle breaks in passive/attributive use ('was obtained' -> 'was got'). Keep 'obtained' or restructure to active voice with 'get'.
